text.p: Tropical cyclone Justin is weakening in the Coral Sea as it picks up speed and heads towards the Queensland Coast. Justin will continue to threan shipping during the next 24 hours with top winds up to 50 or 55 mph. Landfall is expected near Cairns Australia in about 24 hours. Top winds near landfall should be about 40-45 mph. Locally heavy rain may cause some flooding as the system moves inland and dissipates in 24-36 hours.
There are no further emergency statements at this time.
